english: The selected question edits a private configuration draft.
Type an answer and press Enter to continue. An empty answer keeps the displayed value unless the question requests confirmation.
Escape returns to the previous question; Escape from the first question cancels the draft.
Page Up and Page Down scroll long question details.
Tab selects the question heading; ? then opens its help. Tab or Enter returns to the answer.
Question marks in the answer field are ordinary text, including the first character.
Changes take effect only after the final Save or Apply action. Connection changes apply on the next connection.
Application preferences apply across the client; server settings belong to the selected server profile.
